recipes.name: Cheesy Blasters inspired by 30 Rock
instructions: Make some pizza dough - Pizza dough
Cut dough into 4 equal pieces. Roll out one piece on a floured surface until it’s a circle. - Flour
Once your dough is rolled out, cook some spicy italian sausage in a pan, and be sure to crumble it up. - Spicy Italian Sausage
While your sausage is cooking, dice up some pepperoni, genoa salami, and some hard salami (any 3 salamis will do). - Pepperoni - Genoa salami - Hard salami

Add some pizza sauce to your dough and top with some low moisture mozzarella followed by your 3 salamis, spicy Italian sausage, and some ricotta cheese. - Pizza sauce - Low moisture mozzarella - Ricotta cheese
Fold dough over and turn in the edges similar to an empanada. Cut three slits for steam in the top. Cover with an egg wash and place in a 500°F oven for about 20 minutes. - Eggs
Let sit for 10-15 minutes to cool. Serve and enjoy!
